jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
BoomerangFX

Location:
Mississauga, Ontario — on-site, five days per week
Reports to:
Chief Executive Officer

Mandatory Experience

A Canadian CPA designation and hands-on experience leading finance and operations for a PE-backed SaaS company scaling ARR from $5 million to $50 million.

Why Join BoomerangFX?

BoomerangFX is a global healthcare technology company bringing SaaS, artificial intelligence and digital marketing together to help private-pay healthcare practices operate and grow. Recognized through Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500 program, we are building technology that simplifies practice management, strengthens patient engagement and helps healthcare businesses reach more people.
With operations in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia and India
, we are scaling internationally and working at the forefront of AI in healthcare. Our teams collaborate across countries and disciplines to turn new ideas into products and services that make a practical difference for customers.

Joining BoomerangFX is an opportunity to build your career alongside a growing global business. You will have meaningful responsibility, exposure to international markets and the opportunity to contribute ideas, develop your skills and see the impact of your work. We welcome people who take ownership, move quickly and want to help build what comes next.

The Role

Reporting to the CEO, you will lead financial management and general operations with strong financial acumen, commercial judgment and a practical approach to execution
.

You will oversee the Controller and Accountant
while taking responsibility for talent acquisition, human resources, vendor negotiations and corporate infrastructure
. You must be comfortable reviewing the detail, challenging assumptions and resolving issues personally while building an accountable team.

Financial Leadership and Accounting Oversight

Directly oversee the Controller and Accountant, setting clear expectations for accuracy, reporting deadlines, financial controls and accountability. Review their work and provide hands-on guidance on complex issues.
Own the quality and timeliness of monthly, quarterly and annual financial reporting. Review financial statements, balance-sheet reconciliations, management reports and material accounting judgments.
Oversee billing, subscription revenue recognition, deferred revenue, collections, accounts payable, payroll and intercompany reporting. Maintain clear controls over approvals, payments and financial records.
Coordinate external accountants, auditors and tax advisers, and strengthen accounting policies and controls as the company scales.

Financial Performance and Cash Management

Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, financial modelling and variance analysis. Challenge assumptions and translate financial results into clear recommendations for the CEO and department leaders.
Own a rolling 13-week cash-flow forecast and longer-term liquidity projections. Improve collections, working capital, spending discipline and visibility into financial commitments.
Analyze profitability by product, service and market. Use SaaS metrics, including ARR, retention, churn, gross margin, customer acquisition cost and payback, to evaluate performance and investment decisions.
Assess hiring plans, pricing, operating costs and major expenditures against expected returns. Drive measurable improvements in margins, productivity and progress toward sustainable profitability.

Talent Acquisition and Human Resources

Oversee talent acquisition and human resources, including internal staff and external providers. Align recruitment priorities and headcount plans with approved budgets and business needs.
Oversee recruitment execution, agency relationships, hiring timelines, onboarding and workforce planning. Hold hiring managers accountable for clear requirements, timely decisions and hiring outcomes.
Oversee HR administration, employee records, compensation and benefits coordination, performance-review processes, employee relations and offboarding, working with qualified advisers where required.

Vendor Negotiations and Corporate Infrastructure

Lead vendor negotiations and oversee procurement, contracts and renewals. Secure commercially sound pricing, payment terms and service commitments, and hold providers accountable for delivery.
Oversee corporate infrastructure, including offices, facilities, equipment, business systems and outsourced services. Ensure these resources support reliable daily operations and future growth.
Work with technology leaders on corporate IT providers, software licences, infrastructure spending and business continuity arrangements. Improve utilization and eliminate unnecessary or duplicate costs.

Operating Performance and Team Leadership

Establish operating KPIs, management dashboards and regular performance reviews across finance and the functions under your oversight.
Improve workflows, approval processes and reporting through practical automation and stronger data quality. Ensure corrective actions have accountable owners and deadlines.
Lead and develop the finance team and collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product and Technology leaders to improve execution and resource allocation.

Mandatory Qualifications

CPA designation in good standing in Canada.

At least 5-7 years of progressive finance experience, including hands-on leadership across financial reporting, controllership, budgeting, forecasting, cash management and operating performance.
At least three years of hands-on experience in a fast-paced SaaS business, including leadership of finance and operations for a PE-backed SaaS company scaling ARR from $5 million to $50 million.

Strong financial acumen and commercial judgment: the ability to interrogate financial results, build credible forecasts, evaluate SaaS unit economics and make sound decisions on costs, headcount and investment.
Proven experience directly supervising a Controller and accounting staff, reviewing their work and maintaining high standards for financial accuracy, control and delivery.
Direct experience overseeing talent acquisition, human resources, vendor negotiations and corporate infrastructure, with accountability for operational results.
Advanced financial modelling and Excel or Google Sheets skills, proficiency with accounting and reporting systems, and the ability to explain financial issues clearly to business leaders.
A record of personal ownership and effective execution in an environment with rapidly changing priorities, tight deadlines and limited resources. You must be willing to work on-site in Mississauga five days per week.

Additional Experience We Value

Measurable success improving profitability, cash generation or progress toward break-even.
Experience managing multiple entities, currencies or international operations.
Experience in healthcare technology or a business combining SaaS subscriptions and services.
Experience implementing finance systems, automating reporting or supporting transaction readiness.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary:
CAD $135,000–$150,000 annually.
Annual target performance bonus:
50% of base salary, based on achievement of agreed performance objectives.
Total target compensation:
CAD $202,500–$225,000 annually.
Performance objectives will reflect measurable outcomes in profitability, cash management, financial reporting and operational execution.
Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage.
Paid vacation and free on-site parking.
An opportunity to work closely with the CEO and senior leadership and make a measurable contribution to a growing global healthcare technology business.

How to Apply

Submit your résumé with a brief summary of your experience in high-growth software or technology-enabled companies, including two or three measurable financial or operational results you personally delivered.
Shortlisted candidates should be prepared to discuss their experience with financial oversight, operational leadership, strategic planning, and board reporting. CPA credentials, employment experience, and professional references will be verified.

Accessibility Statement

BoomerangFX is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and are dedicated to accommodating people with disabilities. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process, please contact recruitment@boomerangfx.com.

jobs.title: Regional Finance Director
jobs.description:
Company Description
Recursive focuses on building self-improving superintelligent systems to automate knowledge discovery across complex domains. The organization is driven by a mission to accelerate scientific and technological progress through advanced AI. Team members collaborate across disciplines to design tools that transform how information is analyzed, synthesized, and applied. Recursive values innovation, rigorous thinking, and scalable solutions that have meaningful real-world impact. Joining Recursive means contributing to cutting-edge work in AI while helping shape the future of knowledge discovery.
Role Description
The Regional Finance Director is a full-time remote role responsible for leading financial planning, analysis, and reporting for a designated region. This role oversees budgeting and forecasting processes, reviews regional financial statements, and provides insight to support strategic decision-making. The Regional Finance Director partners with business leaders to evaluate performance, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure alignment with global financial goals. Daily responsibilities include preparing and reviewing monthly and quarterly reports, monitoring key financial metrics, and ensuring compliance with internal controls and policies. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, supports audits, and helps implement standardized financial practices across the region.
Qualifications

Strong foundation in Finance with experience in regional or multi-country financial management.
Proficiency in Financial Planning and budgeting, including forecasting and scenario analysis.
Experience preparing and interpreting Financial Statements and ensuring accurate period-end close.
Demonstrated Analytical Skills and ability to translate data into clear business insights.
Hands-on experience with Financial Reporting, including management reports and dashboards.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., CPA, CFA) is beneficial.
Strong proficiency with financial systems and tools (e.g., ERP platforms, Excel, BI tools).
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote, distributed team.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain high attention to detail.
Experience in technology, AI, or high-growth environments is an advantage.

Full-time

jobs.title: Technology and Innovation - Associate Director (NetSuite)
jobs.description:
Riveron is looking for an Associate Director to join our Technology and Innovation practice. This client facing role will interact with key leadership (CFO, Controller, etc.) and will contribute to the areas of business development and sales, practice development, and project execution.

As an Associate Director, you will lead the delivery of client engagements, serving as the day-to-day point of contact for the client, guiding a team of consultants through the project lifecycle, and ensuring that high quality projects are consistently executed on time and on budget. While developing your project and people management skills, you will further augment your advisory toolkit by digging deep into client problems in real-time and delivering ongoing thought partnership. With business leaders to guide you along the way – including a dedicated performance advisor – you will contribute to developing the practice as we continue to invest in accelerating your growth.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Accounting, Finance, or Management Information Systems (MIS)
7+ years of implementation or optimization experience and should have prior experience with architecting ERP solutions on NetSuite.
Leading or supporting full-cycle NetSuite Implementations
Previous experience and ability to gather business requirements and effectively implement an ERP, CRM, & PSA solution
Mastery of Microsoft Office Products.
Consulting experience in other business applications including QuickBooks, Intacct, Salesforce.com, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP, and/or PeopleSoft is a plus.
Software as a Service (SaaS) or Cloud experience is a plus.
Certified NetSuite ERP consultant is a plus.
Ability to develop, grow and sustain client relationships.
Entrepreneurial spirit and a solution-oriented mindset
Ability to work in ever-changing, dynamic environments.
Ability to craft and deliver verbal, written, and oral messages and make recommendations to a variety of audiences, including client leadership and internal teams.
Desire to get involved in the Riveron culture and internal initiatives, including community service, training, interviewing, intramurals, and other social/networking activities.
Passionate about best practices and the ability to challenge the need for customization and not just using standard native functionality by configuring the platform.

What You'll Do

Execute Projects

Collaborate with Implementation team members to develop effective and scalable NetSuite solutions. Leverage best practices wherever possible.
Work directly with Implementation team members to develop business requirements and translate requirements into specific NetSuite functionality.
Lead client workshops to define implementation strategy to support the growth of the business requirements.
Lead and/or support implementation team(s) in solution design and work with the implementation team to implement the solution.
Work with client IT teams to ensure that the solution design is well understood by the client. Should be comfortable presenting the solution design to the external and internal teams.
Ensure completion of tasks, milestones, and components including but not limited to functional specifications, design specifications, configurations, quality assurance, implementations and project reviews for engagements.
Define integration requirements and collaborate with integration team to interface other outside applications with NetSuite.
Oversee and lead engagement teams through all phases of a NetSuite ERP implementation or optimization project including business process design, configuration, user acceptance testing, training, cutover and go-live stabilization.

Support Business Development and Sales

Identify expansion opportunities on client engagements to cross-sell Riveron’s services
Participate in pre-sales meetings with current and prospective clients to assess project level-of-effort and to assist in determining in NetSuite is the best fit for requirements presented.
Identify the NetSuite modules and determine the timeline, resource plan, level-of-effort and fee estimates required for implementation in achieving client objectives.

NetSuite Practice Development

Work with practice leadership to develop and deliver NetSuite-specific training, business development training and collateral and engagement materials/templates.

Applications for this evergreen opportunity will be accepted through Dec 31, 2026.

About Riveron

At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high-growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. We are committed to fostering growth, both for our clients and our people, through mentorship, integrity, and a client-centric approach. This inclusive environment offers flexibility, progressive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for impactful work that supports well-being in and out of the office.

Want to stay connected with Riveron? Join our Talent Community to learn more about our growing firm and be considered for future opportunities.

Check Us Out On Social Media

LinkedIn Glassdoor Instagram Facebook

Riveron Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer and believes that we are stronger together through our diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

Full time roles are eligible for a full range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, and PTO. A complete description of all available benefits can be found at Riveron's Benefits page at https://riveron.com/riveron-life/. Contract roles are not eligible for benefits.

Fraud Alert

Please beware of fraudulent schemes or impersonations when going through the job application process. A Riveron employee will never recruit via text or extend unsolicited employment offers. Additionally, a Riveron employee will never ask you to exchange money or purchase anything as part of the recruiting process.

Artificial intelligence (AI) tools are used to support the hiring process in screening, assessing, and/or selecting applicants for this position. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Compensation Range: CA$162K - CA$190K
